verdict.rationale: 1Password documents an official Environments MCP Server that MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kiro can use to manage 1Password Environments. A runtime probe also confirmed a second official public docs MCP server completing a full initialize handshake. missing for 10: the Environments MCP Server is labeled Beta and limited in scope to Environments (it does not return secrets or cover general vault items), and there is little detailed setup or configuration documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The 1Password Environments MCP Server lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro securely manage your 1Password Environments.
1Password's public docs MCP server at https://www.1password.dev/mcp completed a FULL keyless initialize handshake
